visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a white electric stand mixer kneading a pale, elastic dough in a stainless steel bowl. The lighting is bright and even, reflecting off the white marble-textured countertop. (2) The scene shifts to display prepared fillings: purple red bean paste balls on a gray plate, followed by shredded cheese and diced ham on another plate. (3) A woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a white sleeveless top, is seen in a clean, modern kitchen cutting a large mass of dough into smaller portions using a bench scraper. A smartphone on a tripod is visible in the frame, filming her actions. (4) Close-up shots focus on the hands carefully stuffing the dough portions with cheese, ham, and red bean paste, then pinching them closed and rolling them into smooth balls. (5) The woman demonstrates a round, dark gray springform baking tin, showing how the side latch works. (6) The stuffed dough balls are placed inside the tin in a circular arrangement to form a flower shape. (7) Several trays containing shaped dough and the tin are slid into a sleek, white built-in oven. (8) After baking, the buns are brushed with a liquid glaze using a silicone brush, and almond slices and black sesame seeds are sprinkled on top as garnishes. (9) Using thick, striped oven mitts, the woman removes the golden-brown, puffed-up bread from the oven and places it on a metal cooling rack. (10) A close-up shows hands pulling apart one of the buns, revealing a generous amount of dark red bean filling inside. (11) Finally, the large pull-apart bread is placed into a clear plastic bag with white decorative text for packaging.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 女兒開學第五週. (2) [Subtitle]: 我繼續幫她準備麵包. (3) [Subtitle]: 沒想到粉絲留言跟我說. (4) [Subtitle]: 好期待看你每週要準備什麼麵包喔. (5) [Subtitle]: 我聽了覺得好開心. (6) [Subtitle]: 這週我想到我之前超愛的. (7) [Subtitle]: 手撕餐包把麵包做成跟蛋糕一樣的造型. (8) [Subtitle]: 有紅豆 火腿起司 巧克力三種口味. (9) [Subtitle]: 這麵包真的是有顏值也有美味喔. (10) [Subtitle]: 一整顆帶去學校很方便. (11) [Subtitle]: 結果女兒在車上就吃了3分之1. (12) [Subtitle]: 應該是很好吃吧. (13) [Subtitle]: 她每週都很期待我做什麼麵包. (14) [Subtitle]: 我覺得好有成就感喔. (15) [Subtitle]: 媽媽的愛可以這樣被看見. (16) [Subtitle]: 是不是很幸福呢？. (17) [Subtitle]: 這一大顆麵包. (18) [Subtitle]: 直接包一包就帶去學校了. (19) [Subtitle]: 一起期待下週要做什麼麵包？. (20) [Subtitle]: 食譜在留言區.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a gentle, melodic acoustic guitar track playing in a major key. A female narrator begins speaking in Traditional Chinese with a warm, friendly, and calm tone, providing a steady narrative throughout the video. (2) A soft percussive thud occurs as the narrator mentions preparing bread, which is the sound of dough meeting the marble counter. The BGM maintains a low-energy, steady rhythm. (3) A distinct metallic mechanical click-clack sound is heard, indicating the latching of the springform bread tin. The voice remains consistent in pitch and volume. (4) Further soft impact sounds are audible as individual dough balls are placed into the metal container. The music and speech maintain a balanced mix level. (5) A clear electronic high-pitched 'beep' sounds, serving as the oven notification sound, punctuating the transition to the baking result. (6) A subtle squishy tearing sound accompanies the visual of pulling the bread apart, highlighting its soft texture. (7) The video concludes with the high-frequency rustling and crinkling of a plastic bag as the bread is packed. The voice rises slightly in pitch at the end, inviting viewers to check the recipe.
